card.title: New Rule Required
card.instruction: Use every problem as justification for adding another rule, ceremony, checkpoint, or layer of oversight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The family photo failed because someone blinked. We need a blinking rota.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll rehearse unscheduled blinking before each photograph.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We should appoint someone to monitor rehearsal duration.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 blink causes a rota; A3 unschedulability causes rehearsal; A5 rehearsal time causes monitoring.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 disputes scheduling and A3 adapts it; B4 objects to duration and A5 adds a duration monitor.

relationship.evidence: B2 names an involuntary action and B4 protects the family's afternoon, giving two credible objections.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes B4 time cost generate further oversight, increasing the system rather than solving the photo.
